newsitem.title: USA: Golf - Leading scores at Texas Open after first round.
newsitem.headline: Golf - Leading scores at Texas Open after first round.

text.p: Leading scores at the $1.2 million Texas Open after Thursday's first round, suspended due to darkness with four players still on the par-72 course at the LaCantera Golf Club (players U.S. unless stated):
68 John Morse, Mark Calcavecchia, Kelly Gibson, Woody Austin, Mike Hulbert
69 Donnie Hammond, Tray Tyner, Brian Claar, Tiger Woods, J.L. Lewis

70 Jay Haas, Larry Mize, Dicky Pride, Corey Pavin, Andy Bean, Bob Gilder, David Berganio, Scott Dunlap, Keith Fergus, Sam Randolph, David Ogrin, Ted Tryba, Mike Springer, Tim Herron, Bob Tway, Brian Kamm, Bobby Wadkins, Mike Brisky, Steve Rintoul
Hisayuki Sasaki (Japan) did not finish due to darkness
